$comment: Golden-task set for the claude-harness scaffold's own invariants. Consumed by eval/run-eval.mjs (npm run eval). Hamel L1 = does the structure hold; L2 = does a real scaffold install produce the expected tree. Additive: add tasks, never weaken existing assertions.

level1_invariants.desc: The bundled payload ships exactly 15 skills (one SKILL.md each).
Every bundled skill SKILL.md starts with YAML frontmatter (---).
The bundled payload ships at least 6 lifecycle hook scripts.
Every bundled hook script begins with a bash shebang.
The bundled payload ships at least 1 context-aware rule.
The bundled payload ships at least 1 sub-agent definition.
This repo's own .claude/agents/ is FLAT (no .claude/agents/agents/ double-nest from the forge bug).
An llms.txt agent-readable docs map exists at the repo root.
An AGENTS.md (cross-harness agent instructions) exists at the repo root.
identity/SOUL.md is a real identity, not an unfilled {{AGENT_NAME}} template.
No identity/*.md file contains an unfilled {{...}} placeholder.

level2_scaffold_goldens.desc: Installing the expert tier into a clean dir yields the full harness: 15 skills, >=6 hooks, all bundled rules, settings.local.json, memory/, resources/.
Installing the starter tier yields a minimal harness: 2 skills, 2 hooks, no memory/.
